# game-of-life

Conway's Game of Life (SPACE reseeds)

Category: generative

![game-of-life](../demos/game-of-life.gif)

## Run it

```sh
cd game-of-life && bb run   # from this demo (or jolt run, jolt -M:run)
bb game-of-life             # from the repo root (or jolt -M:game-of-life)
```

## About

raylib [generative] example - Conway's Game of Life. A random soup evolves by the
classic B3/S23 rules on a toroidal grid; SPACE reseeds. State is the set of live
cells.
